title: App shows a blank screen after logging in
body: Since Friday, logging in on Chrome takes me to a white page. The URL is /dashboard but nothing renders. Console shows 'Cannot read properties of null (reading id)'. Clearing cookies and logging in again works once, then it comes back.

title: Session token is dropped on the OAuth redirect
body: We set the session cookie with SameSite=Strict, so it is not sent on the cross-site redirect back from the identity provider. The app then boots with a null user and the dashboard fails to render. Repro: log in via Google on Chrome 120+, watch the Set-Cookie survive but the subsequent GET /api/me return 401.

title: Crash on startup on Windows 11
body: Fresh install, double-click the exe, splash appears then the process exits. Event Viewer: 'The application was unable to start correctly (0xc000007b)'. Installing the VC++ redistributable fixes it, so I think you are shipping a 32-bit DLL next to the 64-bit binary.

title: Crash on startup on macOS Sonoma
body: App bounces once in the dock and quits. Console.app shows 'Library not loaded: @rpath/libssl.3.dylib'. Looks like the dylib is not bundled or the rpath is wrong for the notarized build. Nothing to do with Windows, different library entirely.

title: CSV export contains no rows when a filter is active
body: Filter the table to anything, click Export, and the downloaded file has the header row and nothing else. Without a filter the export is complete. 40k rows in the table.

title: Export ignores the current filter and exports everything
body: Opposite of what I would expect: I filter to 12 rows, export, and get all 40,000. This is on the reports page, not the main table.

title: Exported CSV is empty when filters are applied
body: Applying any filter on /table and exporting gives a 41-byte file. Only the header. I am on the 4.2.1 build. Same as what a colleague reported last week I think.

title: Memory grows until the worker is OOM-killed
body: Our ingest worker climbs about 300MB an hour and gets killed after roughly a day. Heap dump shows a growing list under JobRegistry._completed. Nothing removes finished jobs from it.

title: JobRegistry never evicts completed jobs
body: Reading the code: complete() appends to _completed and there is no eviction anywhere. On a long-running process this is an unbounded list. Probably explains the OOM reports.

title: Dark mode: the settings panel is unreadable
body: Grey text on a slightly different grey background in the settings panel under dark mode. Contrast ratio is about 1.8:1. Every other panel is fine.

title: Timestamps are off by an hour after the DST change
body: All job timestamps in the UI show an hour earlier than the API returns since the clocks went back. The API sends UTC with a Z suffix, so it looks like the frontend is applying a fixed offset rather than the zone.

title: Rate limit returns 500 instead of 429
body: Hammering POST /api/jobs gives a 500 with an empty body once the limiter trips. The limiter raises RateLimitExceeded and nothing maps it to a response, so it falls through to the generic handler.

title: Uploading a file larger than 100MB fails silently
body: The progress bar reaches 100% and then nothing happens; no error, no file. nginx log shows 413. The UI never surfaces it.

title: 413 from the upload endpoint is not shown to the user
body: client_max_body_size is 100m at the proxy. When it rejects, the XHR error handler logs to console and returns without touching the UI state, so the upload appears to hang at 100%.
